gaps: No official Wanderlog OpenAPI spec was found; the CLI is generated from replayable web API, HTML, and community-source evidence.
plan clone/fill apply mode requires WANDERLOG_COOKIE and should only be live-tested against an approved disposable target trip.
Broad standalone ShareDB trip editing and local sync-backed consensus workflows are intentionally out of scope for this focused clone/fill print.

novel_features.name: Shared plan clone/fill
novel_features.description: Create a new Wanderlog trip from a shared or public source plan, then fill it with the source plan template.
novel_features.rationale: Requires combining the public tripPlan read endpoint, cookie-backed trip creation, and ShareDB JSON0 fill operations.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this when the user wants to turn an existing shared Wanderlog plan into their own new editable trip.

novel_features.name: Existing trip fill from template
novel_features.description: Fill an existing Wanderlog trip from a shared or public source plan with dry-run and force safeguards.
novel_features.rationale: Requires reading both source and target plans and applying sanitized ShareDB section/block operations to the target.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this when the user already created a target trip and wants to populate it from a shared template.

novel_features.name: Clone preview and copyability report
novel_features.description: Inspect a shared plan and report dates, sections, blocks, resources, and clone warnings before any write.
novel_features.rationale: Requires normalizing the shared URL/key and extracting source tripPlan/resource structure into a mutation-safe report.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this before clone/fill to confirm what will be copied and whether credentials are needed.

narrative.headline: Clone shared Wanderlog plans into editable trips, then mine guides and places for agent-ready planning.
narrative.value_prop: Use anonymous Wanderlog endpoints to read shared/public plans, guides, geos, places, and category lists. With WANDERLOG_COOKIE, plan clone/fill creates or updates a private trip using ShareDB-backed writes; dry-run and preview modes make the copy plan inspectable before mutation.
narrative.auth_narrative: Public guide, geo, place, category, shared-plan preview, and shared itinerary reads work without credentials. Creating or filling a target trip requires WANDERLOG_COOKIE, including the current connect.sid cookie value in Cookie-header format. ShareDB apply mode is gated behind --apply and should be dogfooded only against an approved disposable target trip.

troubleshoots.symptom: plan clone or plan fill refuses to apply.
troubleshoots.fix: Run the same command with --dry-run first, then set WANDERLOG_COOKIE and pass --apply only for an approved target trip.

troubleshoots.symptom: Personal trip commands return an auth or HTML login response.
troubleshoots.fix: Refresh WANDERLOG_COOKIE with a current connect.sid cookie from a logged-in Wanderlog browser session.

troubleshoots.symptom: A public guide or plan key returns incompatibleItineraryConversion.
troubleshoots.fix: Pass --client-schema-version 2; the public tripPlan endpoint requires the current client schema.

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI when the task is about cloning a shared Wanderlog plan into a new editable trip, filling an existing trip from a public template, previewing shared-plan contents, exporting itineraries, or mining guides and places for agent-ready travel planning context.
anti_triggers: Do not use this CLI to book hotels, flights, restaurants, or paid travel services.
Do not run plan clone/fill apply mode against a real trip unless the user explicitly approves that target.
Do not use this CLI as a general Google Maps scraper.
